events.title: Rocco de Villiers: Springlewendig
events.description: The pianist and entertainer brings his virtuoso playing, infectious energy and trademark humour to an intimate evening at the clubhouse.

events.title: Dirk van der Westhuizen Live
events.description: A big Afrikaans party night of music, dancing and good company on the farm.

events.title: Bring Your Pet to Movie Night: The Secret Life of Pets
events.description: A pet-friendly screening of the animated comedy, so bring the dog along. Tickets are R140.

events.title: Korf tot Kole with Jakkie Louw
events.description: The Southern Cape bee industry association's annual evening of music, food and fun, with Jakkie Louw on stage.

events.title: Open Plan Pictures presents Bakgat
events.description: A screening of the cult Afrikaans school comedy in the relaxed setting of the coffee roastery. Tickets are R100.

events.description: The George Society of Arts stages the Fosse-inspired musical in its final week, with Roxie Hart, Velma Kelly and a razor-sharp score. Tickets are R170 to R200; recommended for ages 16 and up.

events.description: The much-loved Afrikaans singer brings an evening of popular Afrikaans and country hits to a relaxed outdoor lapa.

events.description: A boutique camping festival in a forest valley of the upper Langkloof, mixing acoustic singer-songwriters with electronic sets, fire arts, bonfires and a ceremonial burn.

events.title: Knysna Extreme Triathlon
events.description: Athletes swim the estuary, cycle the wider Garden Route and run to a finish deep in Diepwalle Forest, with a shorter Extreme 0.5 option. Expect activity around Thesen Island and along the route all day.

events.title: Leisure Isle Festival
events.description: The 21st edition of this community favourite brings local makers, food, drinks and family fun, with proceeds going to deserving local charities.

events.title: ForestJAZZ in November
events.description: 34 Waenhout opens its new jazz theatre club with two sessions: a day club with the Bitou Blue Quartet and the Ramon Alexander Trio, and a night club with the Bayfolk Quartet and Offshore Quintet.

events.description: Riaan Smit of Crimson House channels the songs and spirit of Johnny Cash in a relaxed evening at the distillery. Presented by Better Live.

events.title: A Night of Comedy with Alan Committie
events.description: The comedy hall-of-famer brings an all-new stand-up show, flipchart included. No under 13s; unreserved seating.

events.title: Knysna Waterfront Half Marathon
events.description: The Knysna Marathon Club's flat, fast waterfront race over 21.1km, 10km and 5km. There are no race-day entries, and online entries close on 9 November.

events.title: Frank Opperman: Reünie
events.description: Actor and entertainer Frank Opperman plays ten characters in two fundraising shows in Afrikaans. Childcare is available at the Saturday show.

events.title: Plett Mermaid Ball
events.description: An under-the-sea charity ball raising funds for the Plett Shark Spotters. Tickets are R500.
